notes.title: PATCH NOTE 1.5.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30894834/e1a7c276630794ab664fa5b41259c9ca4b9e9a7c.png[/img]

Thanks to your feedback the new SHIELD MODE and BALL CONTROL was much appreciated and validated by the community. We also hear your request for better fight mechanics and a better assist for newcomers. With the V1.52 we introduce you two great new features.

[h1]NEW CONTENT :[/h1]

[b]• Punch : [/b]The punch has a new aura when the punch is charged.

[b]• Level design : [/b]A long work to make the arena more lively has begun. 

[b]• Dynamic moves : [/b]The dynamic materials and bumpers are now active for players.

[h1]NEW FEATURES :[/h1]

[b]• Lock ball :[/b] The lock ball has been re-designed to make interception, punch and access to the ball easier for newcomers. Instead of focusing exclusively on the ball, lock ball will put you on the same height as the ball.  Nevertheless, you will be completely free to adjust your movements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30894834/4703df3a98882ae5b9fe752dd110442a6965aee1.gif[/img]

[b]• Grab : [/b]It is now possible to grab opponents ! When you grab someone his movement are constrained by your movements. Be careful he can knock you out if you grab him too long. 
Grabbing an opponent while one of your friends hits him is a powermove. It’s also very useful to prevent the goalkeeper to stop a ball, or simply grab a striker before he scores ! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30894834/29543a6395524fabe31bdeeea6ed160ee58a23c2.gif[/img]

[h1]BUGFIX/UPDATED :[/h1]

[b]• Ball control : [/b]Backwards ball control is now more accessible, so it is now easier to control the ball.

[b]• Animations : [/b]New set of animations for lateral moves.

[b]• Movements : [/b]Going up and down is now 25 % faster. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30894834/7950f45f728f626b91e777623cefe65142c32547.gif[/img]

[h1]NEXT TO COME[/h1]

Here are our next big works in progress :

[b]• Arenas : [/b]A new low gravity arena is on project + More life into the arenas.

[b]• Sound design : [/b]The sound design during the matches will be enriched. Music, new sounds, voices... 

[b]• Custom games :[/b] More options to custom your games.

[b]• AI :[/b] We need bots, and we need clever ones.

Here is the 1.5. Patchnote (pending) : http://ruckball.com/ruckball-patchnote-history/
To join our Discord : https://discord.gg/KTX2BDH
Ruckball survey : https://forms.gle/xWrjvxizUEtTPrif7

See you in the Arena !

notes.title: RUCKBALL 1.5 update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30894834/51d1bb863f038766b1dcc74a4c935c84c44105d8.png[/img]


Thanks to the awesome feedback from its community, Ruckball, the lovechild of Descent and Speedball improves day after day and is enriched with new content and features.

[h1]NEW CONTENT :[/h1]

• [b]Variable gravity environments[/b]: Until now, Ruckball offered pure zero gravity environments. From now on, each arena will have its own gravity. You will now have to adapt your gameplay to the physics.

• [b]New map[/b]: The new Monolith arena is available! It has two corridors where the fighting is fierce. Monolith is suitable for opportunistic players who will be able to emerge in front of the opponent’s goal at the last moment. The double gravity system also allows exceptional long-range strikes.

• [b]New interface[/b]: The whole UI has been redesigned!

• [b]Shop[/b]: Ruckball shop finally appears! Users will be able to buy Ruckcoins to modify their armor. You can now support Ruckball’s development by purchasing the official sponsors of the 8 countries most represented by our players: United States, France, Germany, Brazil, United Kingdom, Canada, Italy, Russia. We also offer a special FOUNDER bundle.

• [b]HUD[/b]: The life bar of the character is now visible, players names and colors are optimized for a better reading of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30894834/052ba889f8aad53b02ba76da0ba657814b759a4c.gif[/img]


[h1]NEW FEATURES:[/h1]

• [b]Ball control[/b] (in test): Interception now allows you to control the ball and dribble your opponents. You are now in control!

• [b]Shield mode[/b] (in test): The character curls up and becomes invincible. It bounces like a ball. Ideal to propel a teammate or to move away an opponent. The shield mode allows you to float in the air or spin on the walls to maintain your speed without any boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30894834/7669d378b46d4831b373d5855df8ce79aa4a3c43.gif[/img]

[h1]COMPETITION:[/h1]

• [b]Statistics[/b]: Players can now view their careers. Many stats are available in their profile and will allow them to see in which game compartments they need to progress. Yes, competition is about to start…

• [b]Leveling[/b]: Climb the levels by training in fast games.

• [b]Reward[/b]: Win the new skin SOV by reaching level 100! All alpha sponsors in your possession are applicable to this skin.

• [b]Rankings[/b]: Compete against other players by climbing up the rankings: best goalkeepers, best defenders, best striker, best punchers, and number of victories.

[h1]BUGFIX :[/h1] 

No matter how hard we play our game every day, you always find strange bugs that we've never encountered before. Once again, a big thank you to all those who are actively working to improve RUCKBALL experience.  

Here is the 1.5 Patchnote (pending) : http://ruckball.com/ruckball-patchnote-history/
To join our Discord : https://discord.gg/KTX2BDH
Ruckball survey : https://forms.gle/xWrjvxizUEtTPrif7

See you in the Arena !

notes.title: Patch note 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Those past weeks where rich in experience for the team. 
Let’s check out what we have coming up for RUCKBALL.

[b] Community feedback [/b]

A lot of you where asking for a system to speak and organize with your teammates during a game.
[list]
 [*]We added an Ingame quick chat wheel system to speak with other players.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Added more nervosity to the controls modifying the whole character animation blending. 
[*]Fixed minor bug where the ball sometimes doesn’t spawn for clients.
[*]GUI and gameplay sound levels update.
[/list]

[b]Add[/b]

[list]
[*]Charge sound for the charge of the punch.
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*]Several broken animation sequences after the boost.
[/list]

[b]Update [/b]

[list]
[*]We added a limit for the charged punch.
[/list]


We will also release a roadmap for RUCKBALL in the next couple of days.
 
But we can already say that we are currently switching RUCKBALL to dedicated server. We will also release a LAN option for those of you who want to play with friend during the week.

That’s all for this week. See you in the arenas.

http://ruckball.com/ruckball-patchnote-history/

notes.title: PATCH NOTE 1.1.0
notes.notes:
You have been more than 5000 to join RUCKBALL community on the first weekend. Thank you all. 

Unfortunately, the launch wasn't as smooth as we had expected. As you know, until we have the funds to pay for game servers, RUCKBALL multiplayer will be based on a peer-to-peer system. It works very well when players are close and have a reasonably powerful computer, but it can become terrible when both conditions are not met.

The problem is that we have overestimated the average game configuration of our users, which has had the effect of ruining the fluidity of some games. Fortunately not everything was bad, and we were able to watch some exceptional matches. 
 
It was really frustrating for us to know that some of you couldn't play RUCKBALL in good conditions. So, we've been working on that this week. From now on you will no longer be automatically paired with other players, you will be able to create or join ongoing games which will allow you to play under the best conditions. 

Do not hesitate to join the most efficient servers for your comfort of play. If you play with your friends, let the one with the most powerful configuration host your games.

In addition, some of you have encountered freezes, others had problems with their key bindings. We hope that the last patch will allow a return to normal.

You can read the patch note history here: http://ruckball.com/ruckball-patchnote-history/

Thank you for joining us in such large numbers, it gives us strength. See you in the arena, 19h00 UTC !

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hey, sumos!

After long weeks of discussions with Steam support and numerous patches, all systems are go ! We are pleased to announce the launch of the Sumocrats demo on Friday, March 9th at 5pm GMT.
It will be available for free as a downloadable demo from the Steam store page of Sumocrats, it will remain live for one week.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30894834/2c17007b95377030426fcb57d9a8213a5e43b303.png[/img]

On the program of this first version :

– Tutorial: to understand the rudiments of space sumo
– Auto matchmaking : 2V2 on 2 different arenas.
– Escouade : Possibility of inviting a friend on steam to form your team.
– Custom : which will allow you to customize your Sumocrats.

Be aware that the game is still under development. You will probably encounter many bugs or design incoherences. Thank you for reporting them on the SUMOCRATS Discord to help us improve the game.

We have been working on SUMOCRATS for two years now. This Friday is a great day for us ! We’ll celebrate online with you all weekend and even the night for some! … Try to beat us 😉

Thank you again for your patience and all your encouraging messages. See you soon in the arena!

ArkRep team : Fabien, Cesar, Laurianne, Guillaume & Guillaume, Olivier, Stéphane.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30894834/53e020b8074cfe4cfb3ab4cdc25bbac8a7f989c1.jpg[/img]
